# computesphere_database_connection (Data Source)

Reads how to connect to a SphereDB database: the pooled route (for your app) and the direct route (for tools and migrations), and the public routes when public access is on. Private hosts are reachable only from services in the database's environment. With `reveal = true` the password is included, stored in Terraform state, and each read is recorded in the account's activity log.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "computesphere_database_connection" "example" {
  database_id = "d1e2f3a4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
}

# Host and port of the pooled route, for an app in the same environment.
output "pooled_endpoint" {
  value = "${data.computesphere_database_connection.example.pooled.host}:${data.computesphere_database_connection.example.pooled.port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Database id.

### Optional

- `reveal` (Boolean) Include the password. Needs write access to the project. Default false: the password is masked.

### Read-Only

- `ca_certificate` (String) `documentdb` only: PEM CA certificates the private routes' URIs verify against.
- `ca_certificate_filename` (String) `documentdb` only: the file name the URIs expect `ca_certificate` to be saved as.
- `ca_file` (String) Where an app in the environment finds the CA certificate for `sslmode=verify-full`; null when there is none.
- `direct` (Attributes) Direct route to the primary, for tools and migrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--direct))
- `engine` (String) Database engine, e.g. `postgresql`.
- `pooled` (Attributes) Pooled route, for your app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pooled))
- `public_ca_certificate` (String) PEM CA certificate the public routes' URIs verify against, when present; otherwise they use the system trust store.
- `public_ca_certificate_filename` (String) The file name the public URIs expect `public_ca_certificate` to be saved as.
- `public_direct` (Attributes) Direct route on the public hostname; null unless public access is on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_direct))
- `public_pooled` (Attributes) Pooled route on the public hostname; null unless public access is on and the pooled route is served there. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_pooled))
- `revealed` (Boolean) Whether the password is included.
- `sslmode` (String) TLS mode the private routes' URIs use.
